prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game GUI facility background candidate for a JRPG static prototype
Primary request: Create a wide 16:9 mature fantasy anime JRPG background for the Ice-region magic shop facility, display name: 冰燈魔法商店. This is a new v01 candidate, not a replacement of an existing asset.
Scene/backdrop: Interior of an ice-lantern magic shop: wet dark wood shelves, brass and blue-glass lanterns, sealed spellbooks, star charts, crystal tools, hanging charms, sea-fogged windows on the left, distant cold harbor silhouettes, salt frost on glass and metal. Preserve readable left and middle background depth for GUI panels.
Subject: 伊芙, adult female magic shop keeper, calm and professional, modest layered navy-and-cream winter robe with fur trim, dark hair with cold blue highlights, holding a spellbook or small ice lantern. She should be clearly different from 米菈 and 諾亞, and not seductive.
Style/medium: polished 2D anime fantasy game background, painterly JRPG facility art, mature and grounded, detailed but not cluttered, matching existing fantasy facility GUI mood.
Composition/framing: 1672x941 target aspect. 伊芙 is a medium-close half-body figure in the right foreground, face in the upper-right safe zone, not cropped, with breathing room from the right edge. Center foreground has a counter with books, crystal tools, and an ice lantern; left side keeps readable shop depth and harbor windows. Keep face and upper torso clear of the bottom action bar area.
Lighting/mood: cold blue magical glow plus warm amber brass lanterns, winter coastal evening, rich but controlled magic-shop atmosphere.
Constraints: no in-image text, no readable signs, no UI panels, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark.
negative_prompt: text, captions, logo, UI panels, signs with readable words, runtime IDs, cropped face, face at image edge, tiny distant NPC, full-body far shot, duplicate female face, same body type, same pose, seductive costume, plain white snowfield, empty ice cave, modern objects, extra fingers, broken hands, warped tools, unreadable clutter, overexposed pure white ice, image with no usable left/middle background depth.
agent_notes: Candidate v01 gives the magic shop a cold harbor ice-lantern identity with 伊芙 in the right foreground and readable left/middle shelving for GUI overlays. It is not installed as the GUI background.
